scripts.emulators: npm run sync-locales && firebase emulators:start --project demo-smartsync
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration && npm run test:push && npm run test:push:trigger
scripts.test:unit: npm run sync-locales && vitest run tests/unit tests/app
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-smartsync --only firestore --config firebase.test.json "vitest run tests/rules --no-file-parallelism"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-smartsync --only auth,firestore --config firebase.test.json "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.test:push: npm run sync-locales && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-smartsync --only firestore --config firebase.test.json "vitest run tests/push/deliver.integration.test.js"
scripts.test:push:trigger: npm run sync-locales && PUSH_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR=1 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-smartsync --only firestore,functions --config firebase.test.json "vitest run tests/push/trigger.integration.test.js"
